correctness.rationale: For all integers n>=3 and 3<=k<=2n-3: (i) every complement of size >= k+2 contains a disconnected k-set via a degree-at-most-two vertex; (ii) complement of size k has obstruction exactly when connected; (iii) every deletion-robust (k+1)-set is a full consecutive 2-by-m block, counted by n-m+1; (iv) two singleton and one double occupancy states give the rational C(z,t) by an exact two-state recurrence; (v) reduced Euler identity and published all-k shellability yield the integer top-sphere rank. A pure-Python standalone finite checker independently verifies the recurrence counts against direct enumeration on 21 (n,k) pairs and face Euler counts for n<=5. Those checks are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Cut-complex homotopy of grid graphs was studied through difficult shellability and small-parameter Betti computations. Providing a natural all-(n,k) complete rank classification for the fundamental two-row family, with a compact rational generating series and new infinite k=5 formula, answers the precise finite-table and topological-computation gap. The fact is not merely a special numerical substitution into known ranks, since it requires an exact structural decomposition of all potential missing faces and a weighted connected-subset enumeration. It may be reused to study asymptotics, parameter recurrences, and checks of wider-grid conjectures; no larger theorem is claimed.
